goals.title: Establish maintained Pi orchestrator fork
goals.description: Maintain a full fork of the earendil-works/pi monorepo, keep main synchronized with upstream, maintain an orchestrator-compat branch, fix rpc-entry resolution and CLI packaging, and run compatibility smoke tests.

goals.title: Complete worker lifecycle monitoring
goals.description: Consume orchestrator events and status, detect completion and failure, expose live Pi UI updates, support cancellation and timeouts, and clean up worker processes deterministically.

goals.title: Implement bounded dependency-aware concurrency
goals.description: Launch two to four isolated workers from the ready queue, enforce dependency and concurrency limits, avoid duplicate dispatch, and schedule newly unblocked tasks deterministically.

goals.title: Validate and commit task work
goals.description: Inspect worker diffs, enforce task scope, run focused validation, reject unsafe output, create coherent conductor-owned commits, record evidence, and clean up completed task worktrees.

goals.title: Build deterministic sequential integration
goals.description: Integrate validated task commits in dependency order on the separate integration branch, refresh task bases after dependencies land, handle conflicts safely, and never merge into the user branch.

goals.title: Add independent review and repair passes
goals.description: Launch fresh reviewer agents for correctness, security, maintainability, tests, and documentation, prioritize findings, and apply important fixes through isolated repair attempts.

goals.title: Deliver final validation and merge-ready evidence
goals.description: Run the complete configured test and lint suite on the integration branch, verify repository cleanliness and history, and report the final branch, commits, reviews, tests, and remaining risks.

goals.title: Harden restart recovery and idempotency
goals.description: Add locked state transitions, schema migrations, daemon restart reconciliation, idempotent retries, orphan branch and worktree cleanup, and safe resume behavior across every run phase.

goals.title: Improve plan editing and approval experience
goals.description: Provide structured DAG visualization and editing, clear validation feedback, configurable worker limits, persisted plan revisions, and a concise final approval summary before side effects.

goals.title: Add run inspection and control commands
goals.description: Add commands and UI for listing runs, viewing task and attempt details, following worker output, retrying or cancelling work, pruning completed resources, and resuming interrupted runs.

goals.title: Expand end-to-end and fault-injection coverage
goals.description: Test real Pi and orchestrator workflows, concurrent scheduling, crashes at each state boundary, Git conflicts, worker failures, malformed state, cancellation, recovery, and platform-specific worktree behavior.

goals.title: Package release and CI automation
goals.description: Add GitHub Actions for checks and upstream compatibility, define versioning and release workflows, validate GitHub installation, prepare npm publication when appropriate, and document supported Pi and orchestrator versions.

goals.title: Define sandbox and permission policy
goals.description: Document the worker trust model, add optional sandbox integration, constrain credentials and destructive tools where possible, and make security boundaries explicit in prompts, configuration, and reports.
